findings.finding: Structural count parity could be read as semantic comparison quality.
findings.resolution: M3.1 reports only merge/split/downgrade semantic coverage and declares count parity non-authoritative.

findings.finding: P36 supervisor supplements could be mistaken for accepted runtime evidence.
findings.resolution: M3.3 consumes the frozen rubric only and records the supplement/runtime boundary.

findings.finding: WorkBuddy prompt-required structures could be directly promoted as FIN packs.
findings.resolution: M3.6 rejects prompt_required and uncorroborated WorkBuddy candidates before registry promotion.

findings.finding: A reviewer action could accidentally imply a planning authority switch.
findings.resolution: M3.7 produces a shadow read model and append-only action trace; M3.8 retains explicit human approval and still forbids M4 cutover.

findings.finding: Cross-sector positives could hide source-policy or negative-control failures.
findings.resolution: M3.4 requires sector/source-policy deltas and M3.5 independently requires relationship, parser and commercial fail-closed controls.

user_confirmation.notes: Current-thread human reviewer explicitly approved M3 and authorized progression to M4. No authority change is approved by this review itself.
